name: Vibration Engineering
description: Basic concept of vibration, Free response of undamped and damped single degree of freedom systems, Forced response of SDOF linear systems, Rotating unbalanced masses, Harmonic motion of the support, Vibration isolation, The superposition principle, Response to Periodic excitation, Free vibration of Two-degree of Freedom system, Natural modes, Beat phenomenon, Undamped Vibration absorber, Multi degree of freedom systems, Rayleigh’s Quotient, Sensors, data acquisition, data analysis, frequency analysis: Fourier transform, FFT, Continuous system, Transverse vibration of string, Continuous models for the axial vibration of rods, Bending vibration of beam.
